title: 20 Colones (Stainless steel)

obverse.description: The arms of Costa Rica (seven stars representing the seven provinces, three extinct volcanoes for the three mountain ranges, two ships symbolizing the country's geographical situation between the Atlantic and Pacific ocean and sunrise on the left), the date below, the country name above, all within a nonagonal rim
obverse.lettering:
COSTA RICA
AMERICA CENTRAL
REPUBLICA DE COSTA RICA
1985
obverse.lettering_translation:
Costa Rica
Central America
Republic of Costa Rica

reverse.description: The value above coffee branches, ribbon behind value and initials of the "Banco Central de Costa Rica" along with the value in Braille, all within a nonagonal rim
reverse.unabridged_legend:
20
Colones
⠃⠚
Banco Central de Costa Rica
reverse.lettering_translation:
20
Colones
20
Central Bank of Costa Rica

comments:
In 1994, 20 colones pieces were struck using both nickel-plated stainless steel and non-nickel-plated stainless steel. The size and space between letters on the obverse and the outer rim of the arms of Costa Rica differ slightly between years.

Although these coins have been demonetized, they are still redeemable at the Central Bank of Costa Rica.
